name: smwmusic-metroid-initiating-self-destruct-quick-escape-remix
title: Metroid - INITIATING SELF-DESTRUCT!!! ~ Quick Escape (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of Quick Escape from Metroid for Super Famicompo 3. Been a while since I did any Metroid music, and I thought I'd do one again for the competition.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" is disabled.

There also two versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. Enables the Siren (turned on default)
2. Disables the Siren

Also included an SPC of the Super Famicompo 3 version that was used for the competition.
